name: liquid-apple-ui-skill
title_zh: 毛玻璃卡片配虹彩网格的苹果风界面套件
tagline_zh: 想要苹果发布会那种通透感，又不想装 node_modules？这套给你 #F5F5F7 虹彩网格底。
tagline_en: Want that Apple-keynote translucency without node_modules? Iridescent #F5F5F7 mesh, 32px frosted cards, tactile.
desc_en: Apple-inspired Cupertino liquid crystal UI design system: iridescent ambient mesh canvas (#F5F5F7), frosted translucent glass cards (backdrop-blur 32px), Apple tactile spring buttons, dynamic status pills, zero-flicker Alpine.js transitions, and zero-bloat standalone Tailwind implementation without node_modules.
why_zh: Tailwind 走独立构建，不碰 npm；backdrop-blur 和弹簧曲线都调到位。
why_en: Standalone Tailwind build, no npm. Backdrop-blur and spring curves are actually tuned — rounded corners alone aren't Cupertino.
limit_zh: 只给视觉层，不含路由、状态管理和数据请求；毛玻璃在低端安卓和旧 Safari 上会掉帧或直接失效，得自己准备降级底色。
limit_en: Visual layer only — no routing, state, or data fetching. Frosted glass stutters or fails on low-end Android and old Safari; bring your own fallback.
title_en: Apple-style UI kit with frosted glass and iridescent mesh
